sources.evidence: New accounts were eligible for a banked reset under the following conditions: September 3, 2026: New Plus, Pro and Business accounts (including new standard and premium seats) created before 10 PM PT.
Existing Plus, Pro and Business users (standard, premium seats) in good standing received a banked reset both on September 3rd and September 4th.
Overview A banked reset is a one-time Codex usage-limit reset saved to your account until you use it or it expires.
Find and use a banked reset If you have a reset available: Open settings → usage on the desktop app, CLI, or on web.
Using a full banked reset refreshes your 5-hour and weekly Codex usage windows and changes your weekly reset date.
automatic resets These are different: A banked reset is saved to your account and must be applied by you.

We do not offer replacement resets, credits, refunds, or other compensation solely because you were ineligible for an offer, did not notice a correctly applied reset, or let an unused banked reset expire.

Thanks for explaining the sequence. A full banked reset refreshes the usage windows and changes your weekly reset date: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11369540 . We haven’t confirmed why another reset appeared early in your account. Please share the redemption and reset times privately with Support so they can check the accounting.

Note: On September 7, 2026, we provided a global reset to Plus, Pro and Business users - this reset applies immediately to your account, and cannot be saved for later, and will not appear as a banked reset.
An automatic or global reset is applied directly to eligible usage limits and does not create a saved reset.
